verses.geez: ወደገመ፡ ኤልዩስ፡ ወይቤ።
verses.translation: And Elius continued, and said,

translations.lxx: And Elius continued, and said,
translations.kjv: Furthermore Elihu answered and said,
translations.ron: Elihu a vorbit mai departe şi a zis:
translations.grk: Ὑπολαβὼν δὲ Ἐλιοὺς, λέγει,

verses.geez: ስምዑኒ፡ ጠቢባን፡ ወአጽምኡኒ፡ ሠናየ፡ ማእምራን።
verses.translation: Hear me, ye wise men; hearken, ye that have knowledge.

translations.lxx: Hear me, ye wise men; hearken, ye that have knowledge.
translations.kjv: Hear my words, O ye wise men; and give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.
translations.ron: "Ascultaţi, înţelepţilor, cuvintele mele şi voi, învăţaţilor, aţintiţi-vă urechile,
translations.grk: Ἀκούσατέ μου σοφοὶ, ἐπιστάμενοι ἐνωτίζεσθε.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ዕዝን፡ ነገረ፡ ይፈልጥ፡ ወጕርዔኒ፡ አክለ፡ ይጥዕም።
verses.translation: For the ear tries words, and the mouth tastes meat.

translations.lxx: For the ear tries words, and the mouth tastes meat.
translations.kjv: For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat.
translations.ron: Fiindcă urechea deosebeşte cuvintele, precum cerul gurii gustă rnâncarea.
translations.grk: Ὅτι οὖς λόγους δοκιμάζει, καὶ λάρυγξ γεύεται βρῶσιν.

verses.geez: ደይነ፡ ንነሥእ፡ ለርእስነ፡ ወነአምር፡ ምንተ፡ ይኄይስ፡ በማእከሌነ።
verses.translation: Let us choose judgment to ourselves: let us know among ourselves what is right.

translations.lxx: Let us choose judgment to ourselves: let us know among ourselves what is right.
translations.kjv: Let us choose to us judgment: let us know among ourselves what is good.
translations.ron: Să cercetăm între noi ce este drept, să ştim între noi ceea ce este bine,
translations.grk: Κρίσιν ἑλώμεθα ἑαυτοῖς, γνῶμεν ἀναμέσον ἑαυτῶν, ὅ, τι καλόν.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ይቤ፡ ኢዮብ፡ ጻድቅ፡ አነ፡ ወሠለጠ፡ ሊተ፡ ኵነኔ፡ ፍትሕየ፡ ወአሐምም፡ በግፍዕ፡ ዘአልብየ፡ አበሳ።
verses.translation: For Job has said, I am righteous: the Lord has removed my judgment.

translations.lxx: For Job has said, I am righteous: the Lord has removed my judgment.
translations.kjv: For Job hath said, I am righteous: and God hath taken away my judgment.
translations.ron: Fiindcă Iov a zis: "Eu sunt drept, dar Dumnezeu nu-mi dă dreptate!
translations.grk: Ὅτι εἴρηκεν Ἰὼβ, δίκαιός εἰμι· ὁ Κύριος ἀπήλλαξέ μου τὸ κρίμα.

verses.geez: መኑ፡ ሰብእ፡ ከመ፡ ኢዮብ፡ ዘይሰትያ፡ ለትዕግሥት፡ ከመ፡ ማይ።
verses.translation: And he has erred in my judgment: my wound is severe without unrighteousness of mine.

translations.lxx: And he has erred in my judgment: my wound is severe without unrighteousness of mine.
translations.kjv: Should I lie against my right? my wound is incurable without transgression.
translations.ron: Deşi nevinovat, trec drept mincinos; rana mea este nevindecată, deşi eu nu am nici o greşeală".
translations.grk: Ἐψεύσατο δὲ τῷ κρίματί μου, βίαιον τὸ βέλος μου ἄνευ ἀδικίας.

verses.geez: ኢአበሰ፡ ወኢጌገየ፡ ግሙራ፡ ወኢተሳተፈ፡ ምስለ፡ ገበርተ፡ ዓመፃ፡ ወኢሖረ፡ ምስለ፡ ኃጥአን።
verses.translation: What man is as Job, drinking scorning like water?

translations.lxx: What man is as Job, drinking scorning like water?
translations.kjv: What man is like Job, who drinketh up scorning like water?
translations.ron: Cine mai este ca Iov, care să bea batjocura, cum ar bea apa?
translations.grk: Τίς ἀνὴρ ὥσπερ Ἰὼβ, πίνων μυκτηρισμὸν ὥσπερ ὕδωρ;

verses.geez: ወይቤ፡ ኢይዋህይዎ፡ ለሰብእ፡ በሩዐቱ፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: saying, I have not sinned, nor committed ungodliness, nor had fellowship with workers of iniquity, to go with the ungodly.

translations.lxx: saying, I have not sinned, nor committed ungodliness, nor had fellowship with workers of iniquity, to go with the ungodly.
translations.kjv: Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, and walketh with wicked men.
translations.ron: Care să se însoţească cu cei care fac nedreptate şi să meargă în pas cu făcătorii de rele?
translations.grk: Οὐχ ἁμαρτῶν οὐδὲ ἀσεβήσας, ἢ οὐδʼ οὐ κοινωνήσας μετὰ ποιούντων τὰ ἄνομα, τοῦ πορευθῆναι μετὰ ἀσεβῶν.

verses.geez: ወይእዜኒ፡ ስምዑኒ፡ ጠቢባነልብ፡ ወኢትፍቅዱ፡ ተአብሱ፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚአብሄር፡ ወኢትሁክዎ፡ ለጻድቅ፡ በቅድመ፡ ዘኵሎ፡ ይመልክ።
verses.translation: For thou shouldest not say, There shall be no visitation of a man, whereas there is a visitation on him from the Lord.

translations.lxx: For thou shouldest not say, There shall be no visitation of a man, whereas there is a visitation on him from the Lord.
translations.kjv: For he hath said, It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.
translations.ron: Căci Iov a zis: "Omul n-are nici un folos, dacă se străduieşte să fie plăcut lui Dumnezeu".
translations.grk: Μὴ γὰρ εἴπῃς, ὅτι οὐκ ἔσται ἐπισκοπὴ ἀνδρός, καὶ ἐπισκοπὴ αὐτῷ παρὰ Κυρίου.

verses.geez: ወይፈድዮ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ በከመ፡ ምግባሩ፡ ወይረክቦ፡ ለሰብእ፡ በከመ፡ ፍኖቱ።
verses.translation: Wherefore hear me, ye that are wise in heart: far be it from me to sin before the Lord, and to pervert righteousness before the Almighty.

translations.lxx: Wherefore hear me, ye that are wise in heart: far be it from me to sin before the Lord, and to pervert righteousness before the Almighty.
translations.kjv: Therefore hearken unto me ye men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness; and from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
translations.ron: Dar voi oameni de inimă, ascultaţi-mă! Departe este de Dumnezeu răutatea, departe este de El nedreptatea!
translations.grk: Διὸ συνετοὶ καρδίας ἀκούσατέ μου, μή μοι εἴη ἔναντι Κυρίου ἀσεβῆσαι, καὶ ἔναντι παντοκράτορος ταράξαι τὸ δίκαιον.

verses.geez: ትሬስዮኑ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ከመ፡ ይገፍዕ፡ ወዘኵሎ፡ ይመልክ፡ ከመ፡ ይዌልጥ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ዘውእቱ፡ ፈጠራ፡ ለምድር።
verses.translation: Yea, he renders to a man accordingly as each of them does, and in a man's path he will find him.

translations.lxx: Yea, he renders to a man accordingly as each of them does, and in a man's path he will find him.
translations.kjv: For the work of a man shall he render unto him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.
translations.ron: Căci Dumnezeu întoarce omului după faptele lui şi se poartă cu fiecare după purtarea lui.
translations.grk: Ἀλλὰ ἀποδιδοῖ ἀνθρώπῳ καθὰ ποιεῖ ἕκαστος αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐν τρίβῳ ἀνδρὸς εὑρήσει αὐτόν.

verses.geez: መኑ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘገብረ፡ ዘታሕተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ዘውስቴታ።
verses.translation: And thinkest thou that the Lord will do wrong, or will the Almighty who made the earth wrest judgment?

translations.lxx: And thinkest thou that the Lord will do wrong, or will the Almighty who made the earth wrest judgment?
translations.kjv: Yea, surely God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.
translations.ron: Cu adevărat, Dumnezeu nu făptuieşte răul şi Cel Atotputernic nu strâmbă dreptatea.
translations.grk: Οἴει δὲ τὸν Κύριον ἄτοπα ποιήσειν, ἢ ὁ παντοκράτωρ ταράξει κρίσιν,

verses.geez: ወለእመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ፈቀደ፡ ያጸንዕ፡ ወይእኅዝ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ዘኀቤሁ።
verses.translation: And who is he that made the whole world under heaven, and all things therein?

translations.lxx: And who is he that made the whole world under heaven, and all things therein?
translations.kjv: Who hath given him a charge over the earth? or who hath disposed the whole world?
translations.ron: Cine i-a încredinţat cârmuirea pământului şi cine i-a dat în grijă această lume întreagă?
translations.grk: ὃς ἐποίησε τὴν γῆν; Τίς δέ ἐστιν ὁ ποιῶν τὴν ὑπʼ οὐρανὸν, καὶ τὰ ἐνόντα πάντα;

verses.geez: ወይመውት፡ ኵሊ፡ ዘሥጋ፡ ኅቡረ፡ ኵሉ፡ መዋቲ፡ ወውስተ፡ መሬት፡ ይገብእ፡ እምኀበ፡ ተፈጥረ።
verses.translation: For if he would confine, and restrain his spirit with himself;

translations.lxx: For if he would confine, and restrain his spirit with himself;
translations.kjv: If he set his heart upon man, if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;
translations.ron: Dacă Dumnezeu n-ar cugeta decât la Sine Însuşi şi dacă ar lua înapoi la Sine duhul Său şi suflarea Sa,
translations.grk: Εἰ γὰρ βούλοιτο συνέχειν, καὶ τὸ σνεῦμα παρʼ αὐτῷ κατασχεῖν,

verses.geez: ወእመአኮሰ፡ ተገሠዕ፡ ወስማዕ፡ ዘንተ፡ ነገረ፡ ወአጽእ፡ ቃለ፡ በገርየ፡ አንተ።
verses.translation: all flesh would die together, and every mortal would return to the earth, whence also he was formed.

translations.lxx: all flesh would die together, and every mortal would return to the earth, whence also he was formed.
translations.kjv: All flesh shall perish together, and man shall turn again unto dust.
translations.ron: Toate făpturile ar pieri deodată şi omul s-ar întoarce în ţărână.
translations.grk: τελευτήσει πᾶσα σὰρξ ὁμοθυμαδὸν, πᾶς δὲ βροτὸς εἰς γῆν ἀπελεύσεται, ὅθεν καὶ ἐπλάσθη.

verses.geez: ዝኩ፡ ዘይጸልእ፡ ዓመፃ፡ ወዘያጠፍኦሙ፡ ለእኩያን፡ ዘለዓለም፡ ጻድቅ።
verses.translation: Take heed lest he rebuke thee: hear this, hearken to the voice of words.

translations.lxx: Take heed lest he rebuke thee: hear this, hearken to the voice of words.
translations.kjv: If now thou hast understanding, hear this: hearken to the voice of my words.
translations.ron: Dacă ai minte, ascultă aceasta, pleacă urechea la cuvintele mele.
translations.grk: Ἴδὲ μὴ νουθετῇ, ἄκουε ταῦτα, ἐνωτίζου φωνὴν ῥημάτων.

verses.geez: ጽሩፍ፡ ዘይብሎ፡ ለንጉሥ፡ አበስከ፡ ወእኩይ፡ ብሂል፡ ለመላእክተ።
verses.translation: Behold then the one that hates iniquities, and that destroys the wicked, who is for ever just.

translations.lxx: Behold then the one that hates iniquities, and that destroys the wicked, who is for ever just.
translations.kjv: Shall even he that hateth right govern? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just?
translations.ron: Unul care prigoneşte dreptatea ar putea oare să domnească? Şi vei osândi tu pe Cel mare şi drept?
translations.grk: Ἴδε σὺ τὸν μισοῦντα ἄνομα, καὶ τὸν ὀλλύντα τοὺς πονηροὺς, ὄντα αἰώνιον δίκαιον.

verses.geez: ዘኢየኃፍር፡ ገጸ፡ ክቡር፡ ወዘኢየአምር፡ አክብሮ፡ ዓቢይ፡ ወዘኢይጌግፅ፡ እምገጾሙ።
verses.translation: He is ungodly that says to a king, Thou art a transgressor, that says to princes, O most ungodly one.

translations.lxx: He is ungodly that says to a king, Thou art a transgressor, that says to princes, O most ungodly one.
translations.kjv: Is it fit to say to a king, Thou art wicked? and to princes, Ye are ungodly?
translations.ron: El, Care strigă împăraţilor: Netrebnicilor! Şi celor mai mari de pe pământ: Nelegiuiţilor!
translations.grk: Ἀσεβὴς ὁ λέγων βασιλεῖ, παρανομεῖς, ἀσεβέστατε τοῖς ἄρχουσιν.

verses.geez: ከንቱ፡ ይረክቦ፡ ለዘይጽርሕ፡ ወኢያጸምኦ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ወገብረ፡ እኩየ፡ ዲበ፡ ምስኪናን።
verses.translation: Such a one as would not reverence the face of an honourable man, neither knows how to give honour to the great, so as that their persons should be respected.

translations.lxx: Such a one as would not reverence the face of an honourable man, neither knows how to give honour to the great, so as that their persons should be respected.
translations.kjv: How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes, nor regardeth the rich more than the poor? for they all are the work of his hands.
translations.ron: El nu caută la fala celor mari şi nu face deosebire între bogat şi sărac, pentru că toţi sunt lucrarea mâinilor Sale.
translations.grk: Ὃς οὐκ ἐπαισχυνθῇ πρόσωπον ἐντίμου, οὐδὲ οἶδε τιμὴν θέσθαι ἁδροῖς θαυμασθῆναι πρόσωπα αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወለሊሁ፡ ይሬኢ፡ ምግባሮ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ምንትኒ፡ ዘይትኃባእ፡ እምኔሁ።
verses.translation: But it shall turn out vanity to them, to cry and beseech a man; for they dealt unlawfully, the poor being turned aside from their right.

translations.lxx: But it shall turn out vanity to them, to cry and beseech a man; for they dealt unlawfully, the poor being turned aside from their right.
translations.kjv: In a moment shall they die, and the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away: and the mighty shall be taken away without hand.
translations.ron: Într-o clipită ei mor şi se duc; în miez de noapte, un popor se zbuciumă şi fără greutate prăbuşeşte pe tiran.
translations.grk: Κενὰ δὲ αὐτοῖς ἀποβήσεται, τὸ κεκραγέναι καὶ δεῖσθαι ἀνδρός· ἐχρήσαντο γὰρ παρανόμως, ἐκκλινομένων ἀδυνάτων.

verses.geez: አልቦ፡ ብሔር፡ ኀበ፡ ይትኃብእዎ፡ ገበርተ፡ ዓመፃ፡ እስመ፡ ኢያምሠጡ፡ እንከ፡ እምእግዚአብሔር፡ ዘኵሎ፡ ይሬኢ።
verses.translation: For he surveys the works of men, and nothing of what they do has escaped him.

translations.lxx: For he surveys the works of men, and nothing of what they do has escaped him.
translations.kjv: For his eyes are upon the ways of man, and he seeth all his goings.
translations.ron: Pentru că ochii Domnului supraveghează cărările omului şi vede toţi paşii lui.
translations.grk: Αὐτὸς γὰρ ὁρατής ἐστιν ἔργων ἀνθρώπων, λέληθε δὲ αὐτὸν οὐδὲν ὧν πράσσουσιν.

verses.geez: ወዘየአምር፡ ዘአልቦ፡ አሠር፡ ክቡራተ፡ ወመንክራተ፡ ዘአልቦ፡ ኍልቊ።
verses.translation: Neither shall there be a place for the workers of iniquity to hide themselves.

translations.lxx: Neither shall there be a place for the workers of iniquity to hide themselves.
translations.kjv: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
translations.ron: Pentru El nu este nici întuneric, nici umbră, unde să se poată ascunde cei ce lucrează nelegiuirea.
translations.grk: Οὐδὲ ἔσται τόπος τοῦ κρυβῆναι τοὺς ποιοῦντας τὰ ἄνομα·

verses.geez: ወዘየአምር፡ ምግባሮሙ፡ ወያገብእ፡ ሌሊተ፡ ወየሐም፡ ሞሙ።
verses.translation: For he will not lay upon a man more than right.

translations.lxx: For he will not lay upon a man more than right.
translations.kjv: For he will not lay upon man more than right; that he should enter into judgment with God.
translations.ron: Dumnezeu n-are nevoie să privească multă vreme pe cineva, ca să-l tragă înaintea judecăţii Sale.
translations.grk: Ὅτι οὐκ ἐπʼ ἄνδρα θήσει ἔτι.

verses.geez: ወያጠፍኦሙ፡ ለኃጥአን፡ ጻድቃንሰ፡ ቅድሙሁ፡ እሙንቱ።
verses.translation: For the Lord looks down upon all men, who comprehends unsearchable things, glorious also and excellent things without number.

translations.lxx: For the Lord looks down upon all men, who comprehends unsearchable things, glorious also and excellent things without number.
translations.kjv: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number, and set others in their stead.
translations.ron: El zdrobeşte pe puternici, fără lungă cercetare şi pune pe alţii în locul lor.
translations.grk: Ὁ γὰρ Κύριος πάντας ἐφορᾷ· ὁ καταλαμβάνων ἀνεξιχνίαστα, ἔνδοξά τε καὶ ἐξαίσια, ὧν οὐκ ἔστιν ἀριθμός.

verses.geez: ወእለሰ፡ ተግኅሡ፡ እምሕግ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኢየአምሩ፡ ኵነኔሁ፡ ከመ፡ ያግብእ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ አውጣተ፡ ነዳያን፡ ወይሰምዕ፡ ገዓረ፡ ምስኪናን።
verses.translation: Who discovers their works, and will bring night about upon them, and they shall be brought low.

translations.lxx: Who discovers their works, and will bring night about upon them, and they shall be brought low.
translations.kjv: Therefore he knoweth their works, and he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
translations.ron: De vreme ce El cunoaşte faptele lor, El îi răstoarnă în fapt de noapte şi-i zdrobeşte.
translations.grk: Ὁ γνωρίζων αὐτῶν τὰ ἔργα, καὶ στρέψει νύκτα καὶ ταπεινωθήσοται.

verses.geez: ወውእቱ፡ ይሁቦሙ፡ ዕረፍተ፡ ወመኑ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘይኴንን፡ ወየሀብእ፡ ገጾ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይሬእዮ፡ ለለሕዝቡ፡ ወለለሰብኡ፡ ኅቡረ።
verses.translation: And he quite destroys the ungodly, for they are seen before him.

translations.lxx: And he quite destroys the ungodly, for they are seen before him.
translations.kjv: He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others;
translations.ron: Ca pe nişte nelegiuiţi ce sunt, El îi loveşte de fală cu foarte mulţi privitori,
translations.grk: Ἔσβεσε δὲ ἀσεβεῖς, ὁρατοὶ δὲ ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወያነግሥ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ብእሴ፡ መደልወ፡ በእንተ፡ እከየ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ዘይብሎ፡ ለኃያል፡ ነሣእኩ፡ ወአልብየ፡ አኅዝ።
verses.translation: Because they turned aside from the law of God, and did not regard his ordinances,

translations.lxx: Because they turned aside from the law of God, and did not regard his ordinances,
translations.kjv: Because they turned back from him, and would not consider any of his ways:
translations.ron: Fiindcă s-au dat la o parte din preajma Sa şi n-au voit să priceapă cărările Sale
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐξέκλιναν ἐκ νόμου Θεοῦ, δικαιώματα δὲ αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐπέγνωσαν,

verses.geez: አነሂ፡ ለልየ፡ እሬኢ፡ ወእንተኒ፡ አርእየኒ፡ እመ፡ ዐመፃ፡ ገብርኩ፡ ወእመ፡ ተናገርኩ፡ ሐሰተ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይድግም፡ ተናገሮ።
verses.translation: so as to bring before him the cry of the needy; for he will hear the cry of the poor.

translations.lxx: so as to bring before him the cry of the needy; for he will hear the cry of the poor.
translations.kjv: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, and he heareth the cry of the afflicted.
translations.ron: Şi au făcut să urce până la Domnul strigătul celui sărac şi să răsune în urechile Sale plânsul celor nenorociţi.
translations.grk: τοῦ ἐπαγαγεῖν ἐπʼ αὐτὸν κραυγὴν πενήτων, καὶ κραυγὴν πτωχῶν εἰσακούσεται.

verses.geez: ቦኑ፡ እምኀቤከ፡ ነሣእክዋ፡ ከመ፡ ትርኀቀኒ፡ አንተ፡ እስመ፡ አንተ፡ ተኃሪ፡ ወአኮ፡ አነ።
verses.translation: And he will give quiet, and who will condemn? and he will hide his face, and who shall see him? whether it be done against a nation, or against a man also:

translations.lxx: And he will give quiet, and who will condemn? and he will hide his face, and who shall see him? whether it be done against a nation, or against a man also:
translations.kjv: When he giveth quietness, who then can make trouble? and when he hideth his face, who then can behold him? whether it be done against a nation, or against a man only:
translations.ron: Dacă Domnul se odihneşte, cine poate să-L smulgă din odihna Lui şi dacă Îşi acoperă faţa, cine poate să-L mai zărească? Dar El stă şi supraveghează şi pe popoare şi pe oameni,
translations.grk: Καὶ αὐτὸς ἡσυχίαν παρέξει, καὶ τίς καταδικάσεται; καὶ κρύψει πρόσωπον, καὶ τίς ὄψεται αὐτόν; καὶ κατὰ ἔθνους, καὶ κατὰ ἀνθρώπου ὁμοῦ.

verses.geez: ወእመቦ፡ ዘተአምር፡ ንግር፡ እስመ፡ ጠቢባነ፡ ልብ፡ ከመዝ፡ ይብሉ፡ ወብእሲ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ይሰምዓኒ፡ ቃልየ።
verses.translation: causing a hypocrite to be king, because of the waywardness of the people.

translations.lxx: causing a hypocrite to be king, because of the waywardness of the people.
translations.kjv: That the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared.
translations.ron: Ca unul Care nu voieşte stăpânirea celor nelegiuiţi, nici poticnirea popoarelor.
translations.grk: Βασιλεύων ἀνθρωπον ὑποκριτὴν ἀπὸ δυσκολίας λαοῦ.

verses.geez: ወኢዮብሰ፡ አኮ፡ ከመ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ዘይትናገር፡ ወነገሩኒ፡ ኢኮነ፡ ከመ፡ ምሁር።
verses.translation: For there is one that says to the Mighty One, I have received blessings; I will not take a pledge:

translations.lxx: For there is one that says to the Mighty One, I have received blessings; I will not take a pledge:
translations.kjv: Surely it is meet to be said unto God, I have borne chastisement, I will not offend any more:
translations.ron: Dacă un făţarnic zice lui Dumnezeu: "Am fost târât la păcat şi nu voi mai face ce este rău,
translations.grk: Ὅτι πρὸς τὸν ἰσχυρὸν ὁ λέγων, εἴληφα, οὐκ ἐνεχυράσω·

verses.geez: ወባሕቱ፡ ተመሀር፡ ኢዮብ፡ ወኢተዘውሥእ፡ እንከ፡ ከመ፡ ዓብዳን።
verses.translation: I will see apart from myself: do thou shew me if I have done unrighteousness; I will not do so any more.

translations.lxx: I will see apart from myself: do thou shew me if I have done unrighteousness; I will not do so any more.
translations.kjv: That which I see not teach thou me: if I have done iniquity, I will do no more.
translations.ron: Ceea ce nu ştiu, Tu învaţă-mă; dacă am săvârşit vreo nedreptate nu voi porni iar de la capăt!"
translations.grk: Ἄνευ ἐμαυτοῦ ὄψομαι· σὺ δεῖξόν μοι, εἰ ἀδικίαν εἰργασάμην, οὐ μὴ προσθήσω.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ኢትወስክ፡ ዕበደ፡ በዲበ፡ ኃጣውኢከ፡ ወይከውነከ፡ ጌጋየ፡ ነቢበ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ነገር፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: Will he take vengeance for it on thee, whereas thou wilt put it far from thee? for thou shalt choose, and not I; and what thou knowest, speak thou.

translations.lxx: Will he take vengeance for it on thee, whereas thou wilt put it far from thee? for thou shalt choose, and not I; and what thou knowest, speak thou.
translations.kjv: Should it be according to thy mind? he will recompense it, whether thou refuse, or whether thou choose; and not I: therefore speak what thou knowest.
translations.ron: Crezi tu, după părerea ta, că Dumnezeu îi va face în schimb tot aşa? Fiindcă ai fost dispreţuitor, fiindcă te faci tu judecător în locul meu, spune-mi atunci ce ştii tu?
translations.grk: Μὴ ἀπὸ σοῦ ἀποτίσει αὐτὴν, ὅτι σὺ ἀπώσῃ; ὅτι σὺ ἐκλέξῃ καὶ οὐκ ἐγώ; καὶ τί ἔγνως, λάλησον.
